void RenderBoundingBox(OBJECT* pObj)
{
    EnableAlphaBlend();

    float Matrix[3][4];
    AngleMatrix(pObj->Angle, Matrix);
    Matrix[0][3] = pObj->Position[0];
    Matrix[1][3] = pObj->Position[1];
    Matrix[2][3] = pObj->Position[2];

    vec3_t BoundingVertices[8];
    Vector(pObj->BoundingBoxMax[0], pObj->BoundingBoxMax[1], pObj->BoundingBoxMax[2], BoundingVertices[0]);
    Vector(pObj->BoundingBoxMax[0], pObj->BoundingBoxMax[1], pObj->BoundingBoxMin[2], BoundingVertices[1]);
    Vector(pObj->BoundingBoxMax[0], pObj->BoundingBoxMin[1], pObj->BoundingBoxMax[2], BoundingVertices[2]);
    Vector(pObj->BoundingBoxMax[0], pObj->BoundingBoxMin[1], pObj->BoundingBoxMin[2], BoundingVertices[3]);
    Vector(pObj->BoundingBoxMin[0], pObj->BoundingBoxMax[1], pObj->BoundingBoxMax[2], BoundingVertices[4]);
    Vector(pObj->BoundingBoxMin[0], pObj->BoundingBoxMax[1], pObj->BoundingBoxMin[2], BoundingVertices[5]);
    Vector(pObj->BoundingBoxMin[0], pObj->BoundingBoxMin[1], pObj->BoundingBoxMax[2], BoundingVertices[6]);
    Vector(pObj->BoundingBoxMin[0], pObj->BoundingBoxMin[1], pObj->BoundingBoxMin[2], BoundingVertices[7]);

    vec3_t TransformVertices[8];
    for (int j = 0; j < 8; j++)
    {
        VectorTransform(BoundingVertices[j], Matrix, TransformVertices[j]);
    }

    IR::Begin(GL_LINES);
    PassthroughShader::Instance().SetUseTexture(false);
    IR::Color3f(0.2f, 0.2f, 0.2f);
    IR::TexCoord2f(1.0F, 1.0F); IR::Vertex3fv(TransformVertices[7]);
    IR::TexCoord2f(1.0F, 0.0F); IR::Vertex3fv(TransformVertices[6]);
    IR::TexCoord2f(0.0F, 0.0F); IR::Vertex3fv(TransformVertices[4]);
    IR::TexCoord2f(0.0F, 1.0F); IR::Vertex3fv(TransformVertices[5]);

    IR::Color3f(0.2f, 0.2f, 0.2f);
    IR::TexCoord2f(0.0F, 1.0F); IR::Vertex3fv(TransformVertices[0]);
    IR::TexCoord2f(1.0F, 1.0F); IR::Vertex3fv(TransformVertices[2]);
    IR::TexCoord2f(1.0F, 0.0F); IR::Vertex3fv(TransformVertices[3]);
    IR::TexCoord2f(0.0F, 0.0F); IR::Vertex3fv(TransformVertices[1]);

    IR::Color3f(0.6f, 0.6f, 0.6f);
    IR::TexCoord2f(1.0F, 1.0F); IR::Vertex3fv(TransformVertices[7]);
    IR::TexCoord2f(1.0F, 0.0F); IR::Vertex3fv(TransformVertices[3]);
    IR::TexCoord2f(0.0F, 0.0F); IR::Vertex3fv(TransformVertices[2]);
    IR::TexCoord2f(0.0F, 1.0F); IR::Vertex3fv(TransformVertices[6]);

    IR::Color3f(0.6f, 0.6f, 0.6f);
    IR::TexCoord2f(0.0F, 1.0F); IR::Vertex3fv(TransformVertices[0]);
    IR::TexCoord2f(1.0F, 1.0F); IR::Vertex3fv(TransformVertices[1]);
    IR::TexCoord2f(1.0F, 0.0F); IR::Vertex3fv(TransformVertices[5]);
    IR::TexCoord2f(0.0F, 0.0F); IR::Vertex3fv(TransformVertices[4]);

    IR::Color3f(0.4f, 0.4f, 0.4f);
    IR::TexCoord2f(1.0F, 1.0F); IR::Vertex3fv(TransformVertices[7]);
    IR::TexCoord2f(1.0F, 0.0F); IR::Vertex3fv(TransformVertices[5]);
    IR::TexCoord2f(0.0F, 0.0F); IR::Vertex3fv(TransformVertices[1]);
    IR::TexCoord2f(0.0F, 1.0F); IR::Vertex3fv(TransformVertices[3]);

    IR::Color3f(0.4f, 0.4f, 0.4f);
    IR::TexCoord2f(0.0F, 1.0F); IR::Vertex3fv(TransformVertices[0]);
    IR::TexCoord2f(1.0F, 1.0F); IR::Vertex3fv(TransformVertices[4]);
    IR::TexCoord2f(1.0F, 0.0F); IR::Vertex3fv(TransformVertices[6]);
    IR::TexCoord2f(0.0F, 0.0F); IR::Vertex3fv(TransformVertices[2]);
    IR::End();
}

t the bottom right corner of the screen.": [["slide", 3, 13, "slot"]], "You can join 'Gens Duprian' or 'Gens Vanert' when you become level 50.": [["slide", 3, 14, "slot"]], "There are certain areas in the world map designated as Battle Zone where only Gens members can enter.": [["slide", 3, 15, "slot"]], "You can get various quests of your level from the Shadow Phantom Soldiers in every village.": [["slide", 3, 16, "slot"]], "Welcome to the world of Mu.;We have been waiting for a hero like you to arrive and put a stop to the chaos brought on to the Mu realm by Kundun.": [["questwords", 1, null, "dialog"]], "Continue listening.": [["questwords", 2, null, "dialog"], ["questwords", 135, null, "dialog"], ["questwords", 192, null, "dialog"], ["questwords", 195, null, "dialog"], ["questwords", 198, null, "dialog"]], "However, journeys such as this are bound to be perilous.;If you wish, we can provide you with a simple tutorial. What do you say?": [["questwords", 3, null, "dialog"]], "A tutorial?;I look forward to it!": [["questwords", 4, null, "dialog"]], "Tutorials are for children. Turn down the offer.": [["questwords", 5, null, "dialog"]], "It won't take up too much of your time. I'll simply explain basic controls and hunting techniques.;Are you sure you don't want our help?": [["questwords", 6, null, "dialog"]], "I have plenty of experience.;To each his own!": [["questwords", 7, null, "dialog"]], "How can I turn him down...?;Alright, let's give it a try!": [["questwords", 8, null, "dialog"]], "I'm glad we can help. We aren't difficult to find.;Simply look for and talk to the Shadow Phantom Soldier in any of the towns.": [["questwords", 9, null, "dialog"]], "I regret we can't be of any help to you.;Here, at least take this present. I hope, the next time we meet, a great warrior stands before my eyes.;Enjoy your time out there.": [["questwords", 10, null, "dialog"]], "I respect your decision to go on this journey.;Allow me to teach you a few simple but essential things you need to know before your adventure in MU begins.": [["questwords", 11, null, "dialog"]], "...This is Noria, the kingdom of Elves! So this is where my adventure begins.;How exhilarating!": [["questwords", 12, null, "dialog"]], "...This is Lorencia, the kingdom of Dark Wizards and Dark Knights! So this is where my adventure begins.;Excellent! My adventure begins!": [["questwords", 13, null, "dialog"]], "...This is Elveland, the kingdom of Summoners! So this is where my adventure begins.;How exhilarating!": [["questwords", 14, null, "dialog"]], "It's nice to meet you.;May I ask who you are?": [["questwords", 15, null, "dialog"]], "Alright! Let's get started with the tutorial.": [["questwords", 16, null, "dialog"]], "Oh, I haven't introduced myself yet. My name is Olga. My fellow comrades from the Shadow Phantom Guardians and I serve Erin Gustiv, the queen of Noria.": [["questwords", 17, null, "dialog"]], "...Shadow Phantom?;Guardians of the queen?": [["questwords", 18, null, "dialog"]], "What are the queen's guardians doing at a place like this?": [["questwords", 19, null, "dialog"]], "The queen's orders are to help those warriors starting out on their journey so that they can at least defend themselves against the forces of Kundun.": [["questwords", 20, null, "dialog"]], "...I'm moved that the queen has made such orders.": [["questwords", 21, null, "dialog"]], "How will you help, exactly?": [["questwords", 22, null, "dialog"]], "I will teach you basic hunting and controls through a simple tutorial.;It's not that difficult, and I'm sure you'll finish it in no time.": [["questwords", 23, null, "dialog"]], "Great! I'll finish this tutorial in no time!": [["questwords", 24, null, "dialog"]], "Excellent! Let's get started with the tutorial.": [["questwords", 25, null, "dialog"]], "Let's start with something simple.;Close your quest window and either press C or click on the Character (C) button located on the bottom right of your screen to launch the Character Stats window.": [["questwords", 26, null, "dialog"]], "Did you launch the Character Stats window?;That window contains the character's name and level, the name of the current server, and character statuses.": [["questwords", 27, null, "dialog"]], "...There's nothing to it. But I would like to learn more....": [["questwords", 28, null, "dialog"]], "Can you explain in more detail?": [["questwords", 29, null, "dialog"]], "We have much to cover. Let's move on to the next step.": [["questwords", 30, null, "dialog"]], "I'll explain this in more detail. What else do you wish to know?": [["questwords", 31, null, "dialog"]], "...I wish to learn about...": [["questwords", 32, null, "dialog"]], "EXP Points and Leveling Up": [["questwords", 33, null, "dialog"]], "Character and Server Selection": [["questwords", 34, null, "dialog"], ["questwords", 38, null, "dialog"]], "Points and Status": [["questwords", 35, null, "dialog"], ["questwords", 39, null, "dialog"]], "Gain EXP points to level up.;You can find out how many more points you need to reach the next level by checking your Character Stats window or the EXP bar located at the bottom of your screen.;The bar is divided into ten segments, and filling them up will elevate you to the next level.": [["questwords", 36, null, "dialog"]], "...Is that right? And then I'd like to learn about...": [["questwords", 37, null, "dialog"]], "You've explained enough. Let's continue with the tutorial.": [["questwords", 40, null, "dialog"]], "The Character Stats window will tell you the name of your character, the name of the current server, and your character's class. It's possible to connect to different channels within a single server using the same character.;There are four basic character classes: the Elf, the Dark Knight, the Dark Wizard, and the Summoner. Reach level 220 with any of these basic characters to unlock the Magic Gladiator, and level 250 to unlock the Dark Lord.": [["questwords", 41, null, "dialog"]], "Leveling up will earn you points. These points can be used to enhance your strength, agility, stamina, and energy and thereby affect your damage, defense, HP, and MP levels, respectively.;Carefully use these points, for how you develop your character will determine its combat characteristics and the types of weapons and skills it can use.": [["questwords", 42, null, "dialog"]], "Now, press the I button or click on the Inventory (I/V) button located on the bottom right to open your Inventory window.": [["questwords", 43, null, "dialog"]], "The Inventory window will display the items you have and the equipments you are wearing.;Click on an item to change its position or, if it's a consumable, right-click on it to use it. Did you get all that?": [["questwords", 44, null, "dialog"]], "Of course I did.": [["questwords", 45, null, "dialog"]], "Quick, on to the next step!": [["questwords", 46, null, "dialog"]], "You are full of zeal! Very well. Let's try adding an item to your inventory. Take the Zen I just gave you and purchase 5 apples from a merchant.": [["questwords", 47, null, "dialog"]], "Finally, a quest! You want me to buy 5 apples from a merchant?": [["questwords", 48, null, "dialog"]], "Excellent! I will be back in a flash.": [["questwords", 49, null, "dialog"]], "Where can I find a merchant?": [["questwords", 50, null, "dialog"]], "Apples can be purchased from potion merchants. In Lorencia, look for Potion Girl Amy, who is located across the bridge (128,85). In Elveland, look for Silvia, who is in the 1 o'clock direction from the center of the square (45,227). In Noria, look for Elf Lala, who is slightly to the north from the town's center (172,124).": [["questwords", 51, null, "dialog"], ["questwords", 221, null, "dialog"]], "...Finding a merchant is more difficult than I thought.": [["questwords", 52, null, "dialog"]], "How do I check coordinates?": [["questwords", 53, null, "dialog"]], "The character's current coordinates are shown on the top left corner of the screen. Movement in the �� or �� direction changes the first number, and movement in the �� or �� direction the second.": [["questwords", 54, null, "dialog"], ["questwords", 222, null, "dialog"]], "It's possible to find out the location of myself and others using coordinates? Amazing!": [["questwords", 55, null, "dialog"]], "Loud and clear! Give me the next quest!": [["questwords", 56, null, "dialog"]], "Go find the merchant in town and bring back 5 apples.;The NPC's name will be shown in light blue, and the point symbol will turn into a tooth symbol when you scroll over it with your mouse.": [["questwords", 57, null, "dialog"]], "Look at the right side of your screen. Do you see the apples you just bought? Adding a potion to the Inventory will automatically register it.;Press the Q button to use apples, potions, and other HP recovery items and the W button to use MP recovery items.": [["questwords", 58, null, "dialog"]], "Whoa! That's really convenient!": [["questwords", 59, null, "dialog"]], "Continue the conversation.": [["questwords", 60, null, "dialog"]], "Since you now have potions, would you like to leave the safe zone and do some real hunting? Are you ready?": [["questwords", 61, null, "dialog"]], "Great! I finally get the chance to show off what I can do.": [["questwords", 62, null, "dialog"]], "Excellent! What is the name of the monster you want me to hunt down?": [["questwords", 63, null, "dialog"], ["questwords", 86, null, "dialog"]], "Explain potions to me once more.": [["questwords", 64, null, "dialog"]], "Go beyond the walls of Noria and hunt down 3 Chain Scorpions.;If you find yourself in trouble, press the Q button to recover your HP. I'm sure this hunt is well within your abilities.": [["questwords", 65, null, "dialog"]], "Go beyond the walls of Lorencia and hunt down 3 Budge Dragons.;If you find yourself in trouble, press the Q button to recover your HP. I'm sure this hunt is well within your abilities.": [["questwords", 66, null, "dialog"]], "Go beyond the walls of Elveland and hunt down 3 Strange Rabbits.;If you find yourself in trouble, press the Q button to recover your HP. I'm sure this hunt is well within your abilities.": [["questwords", 67, null, "dialog"]], "I see you've successfully completed your first hunt! Did you find it difficult? Hunting monsters will earn you EXP points, drop items, and Zens.;You can pick up items dropped by defeated monsters using the mouse or automatically by pressing the space bar.": [["questwords", 68, null, "dialog"]], "Did you say the space bar?": [["questwords", 69, null, "dialog"]], "That will surely make things easier. Do you have any other tips?": [["questwords", 70, null, "dialog"]], "I already knew that. What's the next quest?": [["questwords", 71, null, "dialog"]], "Also, if you find yourself far away from a town or cornered while on a hunt, the Town Portal Scroll can come in really handy. Are you familiar with using it?": [["questwords", 72, null, "dialog"]], "...Town Portal Scroll?": [["questwords", 73, null, "dialog"]], "What is this Town Portal Scroll?": [["questwords", 74, null, "dialog"]], "Of course I know. What's the next quest?": [["questwords", 75, null, "dialog"]], "Town Portal Scrolls can be purchased from potion merchants in towns. They are single-use items that will bring you back to the last town you visited.;Since we're on the subject, will you go and purchase a Town Portal Scroll from the merchant? It'll be easier to understand if you try it for yourself.": [["questwords", 76, null, "dialog"]], "...Hmm. I didn't know such thing existed.": [["questwords", 77, null, "dialog"]], "Very well. How many do I need to buy?": [["questwords", 78, null, "dialog"]], "Go see the potion merchant again and buy just 1 Town Portal Scroll.": [["questwords", 79, null, "dialog"]], "You've done well. Let's see to one more thing before I ask you to face tougher monsters. Talk to me again and receive a damage and defense increase buff.": [["questwords", 80, null, "dialog"]], "A damage and defense increase buff? That sounds great!": [["questwords", 81, null, "dialog"]], "How do I get it?": [["questwords", 82, null, "dialog"]], "Close the Quest window and click on me again. After that, select 'Receive damage and defense increase buff.' This buff is available to anyone under level 220.;After receiving the buff, you will see an icon on the top left corner of the screen, a blue light effect surrounding the character, and have one hour of enhanced damage and defense.": [["questwords", 83, null, "dialog"]], "Excellent! It's time for the next quest. Since you are now familiar with hunting, let's get you to go after a tougher monster.": [["questwords", 84, null, "dialog"]], "Just say the word!": [["questwords", 85, null, "dialog"]], "Go beyond the walls of Noria and hunt down 30 Beetle Monsters. I'm sure this hunt is well within your abilities.": [["questwords", 87, null, "dialog"]], "Go beyond the walls of Lorencia and hunt down 30 Hounds. I'm sure this hunt is well within your abilities.": [["questwords", 88, null, "dialog"]], "Go beyond the walls of Elveland and hunt down 30 Polluted Butterflies. I'm sure this hunt is well within your abilities.": [["questwords", 89, null, "dialog"]], "I see you've now mastered hunting. When you hunt monsters, you can employ normal attacks by left-clicking or use skill attacks by right-clicking.": [["questwords", 90, null, "dialog"]], "...Skill attacks?": [["questwords", 91, null, "dialog"]], "Where can I learn skills?": [["questwords", 92, null, "dialog"]], "This is common knowledge.": [["questwords", 93, null, "dialog"]], "If you are an Agility Elf, whose priority is defense, you can equip a weapon and use its skills. If you are an Energy Elf, whose priority is wizardry, you can purchase orbs to learn skills.": [["questwords", 94, null, "dialog"]], "...How do I do it?": [["questwords", 95, null, "dialog"]], "I want to be an Elf who focuses on defense!": [["questwords", 96, null, "dialog"]], "I want to be an Elf who focuses on wizardry!": [["questwords", 97, null, "dialog"]], "I don't want to decide right now. Just describe them for me.": [["questwords", 98, null, "dialog"]], "So you've decided to become an Agility Elf, a class for whom defense is crucial. Agility Elves are unique in that they employ splendid bow skills. Let me give you a weapon to use so that you can understand better.": [["questwords", 99, null, "dialog"]], "So you've decided to become an Energy Elf, a class for whom wizardry is crucial. Let me give you a weapon to use so that you can understand better.": [["questwords", 101, null, "dialog"]], "Dark Wizards are unique in that they are capable of mastering various magic spells from scrolls and parchments. After purchasing an orb, right-click on it to learn the skill.": [["questwords", 120, null, "dialog"]], "Dark Wizards can learn additional skills by going to Lorencia and purchasing scrolls from Pasi the Mage (119,112) or weapons from Hanzo the Blacksmith (116,142).": [["questwords", 121, null, "dialog"]], "Summoners can learn additional skills by going to Elveland and purchasing scrolls from Marce (36,218). After purchasing a scroll, right-click on it to learn the skill.": [["questwords", 122, null, "dialog"]], "...I see it pays to know a lot of NPCs.": [["questwords", 123, null, "dialog"]], "I understand well. What's the next quest?": [["questwords", 124, null, "dialog"]], "We're nearing the end of our tutorial. Now that you have a skill, it'll make sense for you to build more combat experience. Come back when you reach a certain level, and I will give you a Uniria as a reward.": [["questwords", 125, null, "dialog"]], "...Uniria?": [["questwords", 126, null, "dialog"]], "What's a Uniria?": [["questwords", 127, null, "dialog"]], "What level do I need to be?": [["questwords", 128, null, "dialog"], ["questwords", 131, null, "dialog"]], "Uniria is a mount item you can use out in the battle field. Bring on the test!": [["questwords", 138, null, "dialog"], ["questwords", 142, null, "dialog"]], "I'd rather you give me the gifts without the test.": [["questwords", 139, null, "dialog"]], "The test is simple enough, and it won't matter if you don't get everything right. If you do, however, there's a small bonus gift.;Are you sure you don't want to take the test?": [["questwords", 140, null, "dialog"]], "...A bonus gift if I answer all the questions right?": [["questwords", 141, null, "dialog"]], "I'll just take the queen's gifts without taking the test.": [["questwords", 143, null, "dialog"]], "Here's your first question.;How do you trade with a character that's in front of you?": [["questwords", 144, null, "dialog"]], "...trade...": [["questwords", 145, null, "dialog"]], "Press D and select Trade or type in '/trade' in the Chat window.": [["questwords", 146, null, "dialog"]], "Press D and select Trade or type in '/exchange' in the Chat window.": [["questwords", 147, null, "dialog"]], "Press D and select Trade or type in '/invite' in the Chat window.": [["questwords", 148, null, "dialog"]], "That is correct! Pressing D will give you access to various commands, including Trade, Party, Buy, and Follow. Use these commands well.": [["questwords", 149, null, "dialog"]], "Ah, you've answered incorrectly. To trade, press D and select Trade or face the character and type in '/trade' in the Chat window. Let's skip to the next question.": [["questwords", 150, null, "dialog"]], "When you want to form a party with a character, face that character and enter '/party' in the Chat window. What do you do if you don't want to receive party requests?": [["questwords", 151, null, "dialog"]], "Party request?": [["questwords", 152, null, "dialog"]], "Type in '/off' in the Chat window.": [["questwords", 153, null, "dialog"]], "Type in '/Request off' in the Chat window.": [["questwords", 154, null, "dialog"]], "Type in '/Party off' in the Chat window.": [["questwords", 155, null, "dialog"]], "That is correct! If you don't want to receive party requests while hunting, simply type in '/Request off' in the Chat window. To start receiving party requests again, type in '/Request on' in the Chat window.": [["questwords", 156, null, "dialog"]], "Ah, you've answered incorrectly. Type in '/Request off' in the Chat window to turn down party requests. To start receiving party requests again, type in '/Request on' in the Chat window. Let's skip to the next question.": [["questwords", 157, null, "dialog"]], "Whispers are used to talk to friends who are far away or to pass on private messages. ivate messages, send whispers by using Tab from the Chat window.": [["questwords", 163, null, "dialog"]], "Ah, you've answered incorrectly. In the MU world, you can use the M button to travel with ease, provided that your level is high enough and you have enough money for the destination.;Discovering areas that's right for your level, and hunting there, can also be very fun.": [["questwords", 177, null, "dialog"]], "Ah, you've answered incorrectly. Let's skip to the next question.": [["questwords", 185, null, "dialog"]], "Congratulations. You've completed the tutorial. Take this Ring of Hero and this Ring of Warrior. They are gifts to you from the queen.": [["questwords", 186, null, "dialog"]], "...Finally, the tutorial's finished!": [["questwords", 187, null, "dialog"]], "Ring of Hero? Ring of Warrior? What are they?": [["questwords", 188, null, "dialog"]], "Thank you!": [["questwords", 189, null, "dialog"]], "Ah, I'll have to go far back in time to explain that.;Runedil, the former queen of Elves, was saddened by the loss of all the new warriors of the MU empire, who gave up their lives to constant warring.": [["questwords", 190, null, "dialog"]], "So she imbued rings with the power of the Elves and gave them to warriors in honor of Muren's practice of handing out warriors' rings bearing the emperor's crest.": [["questwords", 193, null, "dialog"]], "That custom all but disappeared when peace finally came. However, Kundun and the chaos he brought motivated Erin Gustiv, the reigning queen of the Elves, to reinstate it.": [["questwords", 196, null, "dialog"]], "Ah. So that's what happened....": [["questwords", 197, null, "dialog"]], "When a warrior who possesses them becomes a consummate expert in his or her art, these rings transform into unique items that will help their master attain greater heights.": [["questwords", 199, null, "dialog"]], "Oh! That will surely come in handy!": [["questwords", 200, null, "dialog"]], "Take the rings.": [["questwords", 201, null, "dialog"]], "You'll be able to use the Ring of Hero at level 40 and the Ring of Warrior at level 80. Dropping the rings will break their seal and transform them into items.;Next time we meet, I sincerely hope to see a mightier warrior before me. Go now and build your experience and strength and free this world from Kundun's grasp!;(You've completed the tutorial.)": [["questwords", 202, null, "dialog"]], "Warrior! Welcome.": [["questwords", 203, null, "dialog"]], "I will guide you through MU game play.": [["questwords", 204, null, "dialog"], ["questwords", 206, null, "dialog"]], "While in a town, seek out the Shadow Phantom Soldier NPC.": [["questwords", 205, null, "dialog"], ["questwords", 208, null, "dialog"], ["questwords", 294, null, "dialog"], ["questwords", 295, null, "dialog"]], "This is the end of the tutorial. Please enjoy your MU experience.": [["questwords", 207, null, "dialog"]], "My name is Olga. My fellow comrades from the Shadow Phantom Guardians and I serve Erin Gustiv, the Elf queen. I am happy to make your acquaintance.": [["questwords", 209, null, "dialog"], ["questwords", 210, null, "dialog"]], "I will teach you hunting and control commands through a simple tutorial.": [["questwords", 211, null, "dialog"]], "Press C or click on the Character (C) button located on the bottom right of your screen to launch the Character Stats window.": [["questwords", 212, null, "dialog"]], "The Character Stats window will tell you the name and level of your character, the name of the current server, and character status information.": [["questwords", 213, null, "dialog"], ["questwords", 214, null, "dialog"]], "Accumulate EXP points to level up. You can find out how many more points you need to reach the next level by checking your Character Stats window or the EXP bar located at the bottom of your screen.": [["questwords", 215, null, "dialog"]], "The Character Stats window will tell you the name of your character, the name of the current server, and your character's class.": [["questwords", 216, null, "dialog"]], "Points gained from leveling up can be used to enhance your strength, agility, stamina, and energy, and thereby affect your damage, defense, HP, and MP levels, respectively.": [["questwords", 217, null, "dialog"]], "Press the I button or click on the Inventory (I/V) button located on the bottom right to open your Inventory window.": [["questwords", 218, null, "dialog"]], "The Inventory window will display the items you have and the equipment you are wearing.": [["questwords", 219, null, "dialog"]], "Purchase and bring back 5 apples from a merchant.": [["questwords", 220, null, "dialog"]], "Go find the merchant in town and bring back 5 apples.": [["questwords", 223, null, "dialog"]], "Press the Q button to use apples, potions, and other HP recovery items, and the W button to use MP recovery items.": [["questwords", 224, null, "dialog"]], "Let's get you some real combat experience.": [["questwords", 225, null, "dialog"]], "Go beyond the walls of Noria and hunt down 3 Chain Scorpions.": [["questwords", 226, null, "dialog"]], "Go beyond the walls of Lorencia and hunt down 3 Budge Dragons.": [["questwords", 227, null, "dialog"]], "Go beyond the walls of Elveland and hunt down 3 Strange Rabbits.": [["questwords", 228, null, "dialog"]], "Hunting monsters will earn you EXP points, drop items, and Zens.": [["questwords", 229, null, "dialog"]], "If you find yourself far away from a town or cornered while on a hunt, the Town Portal Scroll can come in really handy.": [["questwords", 230, null, "dialog"]], "Using a Town Portal Scroll will return you to the last town you visited.": [["questwords", 231, null, "dialog"]], "Purchase and bring back 1 Town Portal Scroll.": [["questwords", 232, null, "dialog"]], "Talk to me again and receive a damage and defense increase buff.": [["questwords", 233, null, "dialog"]], "Close the Quest window and click on me again. After that, select 'Receive damage and defense increase buff.'": [["questwords", 234, null, "dialog"]], "After receiving the buff, you will see an icon on the top left corner of the screen, a blue light effect surrounding the character, and have one hour of enhanced damage and defense.": [["questwords", 235, null, "dialog"]], "Go beyond the walls of Noria and hunt down 30 Beetle Monsters.": [["questwords", 236, null, "dialog"]], "Go beyond the walls of Lorencia and hunt down 30 Hounds.": [["questwords", 237, null, "dialog"]], "Go beyond the walls of Elveland and hunt down 30 Polluted Butterflies.": [["questwords", 238, null, "dialog"]], "When you hunt monsters, you can employ normal attacks by left-clicking or use skill attacks by right-clicking.": [["questwords", 239, null, "dialog"], ["questwords", 240, null, "dialog"], ["questwords", 241, null, "dialog"]], "Agility Elves, whose priority is defense, can learn skills by equipping weapons, and Energy Elves, whose priority is wizardry, by purchasing orbs.": [["questwords", 242, null, "dialog"]], "Let me give you an Agility Elf weapon to use so that you can understand how skills work better.": [["questwords", 243, null, "dialog"]], "Let me give you an Energy Elf's orb to use so that you can understand how skills work better.": [["questwords", 244, null, "dialog"]], "Try equipping the crossbow.": [["questwords", 245, null, "dialog"]], "Try learning the Summon Goblin skill.": [["questwords", 246, null, "dialog"]], "If you are equipped with a weapon imbued with a skill, you can activate that skill by assigning it to the Skill window.": [["questwords", 247, null, "dialog"], ["questwords", 254, null, "dialog"]], "After learning a skill from an orb, you can activate that skill by assigning it to the Skill window.": [["questwords", 248, null, "dialog"]], "The Triple Shot skill should now be one of the skills you can use. Try clicking the icon.": [["questwords", 249, null, "dialog"]], "The Summon Goblin skill should now be one of the skills you can use. Try clicking the icon.": [["questwords", 250, null, "dialog"]], "Let me give you a Dark Knight weapon to use so that you can understand better.": [["questwords", 252, null, "dialog"]], "Try equipping the Double Axe.": [["questwords", 253, null, "dialog"]], "The Falling Slash skill should now be one of the skills you can use. Try clicking the icon.": [["questwords", 255, null, "dialog"]], "Dark Knights can learn additional skills by going to Lorencia and purchasing scrolls from Pasi the Mage (119,112). After purchasing a scroll, right-click on it to learn the skill.": [["questwords", 256, null, "dialog"]], "Let me give you a Dark Wizard's scroll to use so that you can understand better.": [["questwords", 257, null, "dialog"]], "Go ahead and learn the Fire Ball skill.": [["questwords", 258, null, "dialog"]], "After learning a skill from a scroll, you can activate that skill by assigning it to the Skill window.": [["questwords", 259, null, "dialog"]], "The Fire Ball skill should now be one of the skills you can use. Try clicking the icon.": [["questwords", 260, null, "dialog"]], "Scrolls can be purchased from Pasi the Mage (119,112) in Lorencia and Marce (36,218) in Elveland.": [["questwords", 261, null, "dialog"], ["questwords", 262, null, "dialog"]], "Come back when you reach a certain level, and I will give you a Uniria as a reward.": [["questwords", 263, null, "dialog"]], "Come back and see me once you reach level 25. I will give you a Uniria as a reward for your achievement.": [["questwords", 265, null, "dialog"]], "I'll test you to see if you have the basic knowledge required for travel throughout the MU empire and give you the queen's gifts if you pass.": [["questwords", 266, null, "dialog"], ["questwords", 267, null, "dialog"], ["questwords", 268, null, "dialog"]], "What do you do if you want to trade with a character who is in front of you?": [["questwords", 269, null, "dialog"]], "Pressing D will give you access to various commands, including Trade, Party, Buy, and Follow. Use these commands well.": [["questwords", 270, null, "dialog"], ["questwords", 271, null, "dialog"]], "Let me give you a Summoner's scroll to use so that you can understand better.": [["questwords", 272, null, "dialog"]], "What do you do if you don't want to receive party requests?": [["questwords", 273, null, "dialog"]], "If you don't want to receive party requests while hunting, simply type in 'Party off' in the Chat window. To start receiving party requests again, type in 'Request on' in the Chat window.": [["questwords", 274, null, "dialog"], ["questwords", 275, null, "dialog"]], "Which button is used to send whispers from the Chat window?": [["questwords", 276, null, "dialog"]], "When you want to talk to a friend and you know his or her ID, or if you want to pass on private messages, send whispers by using Tab from the Chat window.": [["questwords", 277, null, "dialog"], ["questwords", 278, null, "dialog"]], "When you reach a certain level, you will be able to repair your equipment directly from the Inventory window. What level is that?": [["questwords", 279, null, "dialog"]], "You can have your equipment repaired by Hanzo the Blacksmith (117,140) in Lorencia, Rhea (30, 235) in Elveland, or Eo the Craftsman (194, 123) in Noria. Solicit their services often.": [["questwords", 280, null, "dialog"], ["questwords", 281, null, "dialog"]], "Using the M button, however, it's possible to travel to distant areas in a flash. What is the minimum level you need to be and the amount of Zen you need in order to enter the Dungeon?": [["questwords", 282, null, "dialog"]], "In the MU world, you can use the M button to travel with ease, provided that your level is high enough and you have enough money for the destination. Discovering areas that are right for your level and hunting there can also be very fun.": [["questwords", 283, null, "dialog"], ["questwords", 284, null, "dialog"]], "Who do you need to see to combine items?": [["questwords", 285, null, "dialog"]], "With the help of NPCs in the towns, you can not only combine items, but also enhance your armor by adding jewels to it and much more. Make sure to visit them all.": [["questwords", 286, null, "dialog"], ["questwords", 287, null, "dialog"]], "You have completed the tutorial. Take this Ring of Hero and Ring of Warrior. They are gifts to you from the queen.": [["questwords", 288, null, "dialog"], ["questwords", 289, null, "dialog"], ["questwords", 290, null, "dialog"], ["questwords", 291, null, "dialog"], ["questwords", 292, null, "dialog"], ["questwords", 293, null, "dialog"]], "Welcome to MU.;I'll assist you on your road to becoming a true warrior.": [["questwords", 296, null, "dialog"]], "Receive damage and defense increase buff.": [["questwords", 297, null, "dialog"]], "Accept a quest.": [["questwords", 298, null, "dialog"]], "How do you do? I am Gregory, the Gens Duprian Steward. What is your business with our gens?": [["questwords", 1000, null, "dialog"]], "Ask about Gens Duprian.": [["questwords", 1001, null, "dialog"]], "Ask about the gens dispute.": [["questwords", 1002, null, "dialog"], ["questwords", 1052, null, "dialog"]], "Join Gens Duprian.": [["questwords", 1003, null, "dialog"]], "Leave Gens Duprian.": [["questwords", 1004, null, "dialog"]], "Accept a gens quest.": [["questwords", 1005, null, "dialog"], ["questwords", 1055, null, "dialog"]], "Gens Duprian is a guild of the greatest heroes in Arca and at its heart is the Duprian clan, the mightiest noble bloodline in MU. We are led by Duprian Winston, a knight who knows no equal in the whole of the MU empire.": [["questwords", 1006, null, "dialog"]], "Go back.": [["questwords", 1007, null, "dialog"]], "Gens dispute��? Gens Vanert��s rebellion is more like it. The gens dispute started because of the greed of Vanert Reicht, the commanding knight of Gens Vanert. Exactly five years ago, a band of heroes who were searching in La Cleon for a stone with the power to seal away Kundun were slaughtered. At the time, we believed it was the work of Selupan, a giant spider and the ruler of La Cleon, but soon learned that it was actually Gens Vanert. It is the duty of our proud Gens Duprian champions to retaliate and fight.": [["questwords", 1008, null, "dialog"]], "Oh! You wish to become a member of Gens Duprian? Share our virtues of honor and respect, and help in the fight to crush the greed of Gens Vanert and find the stone that will seal away Kundun.": [["questwords", 1009, null, "dialog"]], "Yes. I wish to join.": [["questwords", 1010, null, "dialog"]], "No. I will give it more thought.": [["questwords", 1011, null, "dialog"]], "If you leave the gens, your contribution will be reset.;Do you still wish to leave?": [["questwords", 1012, null, "dialog"]], "Yes. I wish to leave.": [["questwords", 1013, null, "dialog"]], "Congratulations on becoming a member of Gens Duprian.  Much will be asked of you in the name of our cause. Come see me whenever you require assistance concerning the gens.": [["questwords", 1014, null, "dialog"]], "You cannot join the gens.": [["questwords", 1015, null, "dialog"]], "You cannot leave the gens.": [["questwords", 1016, null, "dialog"]], "You have to be at least level 50 in order to join the gens.": [["questwords", 1017, null, "dialog"]], "You have already joined the gens.": [["questwords", 1018, null, "dialog"]], "Your guild is part of a different gens.": [["questwords", 1019, null, "dialog"]], "You left the gens. Your contribution has been reset to 0.": [["questwords", 1020, null, "dialog"]], "The guild master is not a member of the gens. The guild master must be a member of the gens in order for you to join that gens.": [["questwords", 1021, null, "dialog"]], "You cannot join a gens if you are a member of the guild alliance.": [["questwords", 1022, null, "dialog"]], "The guild master cannot leave the gens.": [["questwords", 1023, null, "dialog"]], "You have not joined the gens. You must first be a member of the gens in order to leave it.": [["questwords", 1024, null, "dialog"]], "You have left the gens.": [["questwords", 1025, null, "dialog"]], "You are a member of a different gens.": [["questwords", 1026, null, "dialog"]], "You cannot join a gens while in a party.": [["questwords", 1027, null, "dialog"]], "What is your business with our gens? I am Conrad, the Gens Vanert Steward.": [["questwords", 1050, null, "dialog"]], "Ask about Gens Vanert.": [["questwords", 1051, null, "dialog"]], "Join Gens Vanert.": [["questwords", 1053, null, "dialog"]], "Leave Gens Vanert.": [["questwords", 1054, null, "dialog"]], "Gens Vanert is a noble family led by Vanert Reicht, the greatest socialite in the whole of the MU empire. The master strives around the clock to put a stop to Duprian Winston and his dream of absolute rule over the empire.": [["questwords", 1056, null, "dialog"]], "Vanert Reicht may have conceded leadership of Noble Alliance Arca to Duprian Winston at the alliance's inception, but the master has always remained committed to eliminating the foul minions of Kundun and to the revival of the MU empire. Everyone knows about Duprian Winston's desires to subjugate the empire under his absolute rule. It's imperative that heroes like you help Vanert Reicht seal away Kundun and restore peace to the MU empire.": [["questwords", 1057, null, "dialog"]], "Hmm... you are a wise warrior. Go now and achieve great things in the name Gens Vanert, knowing that I will always be here to assist you.": [["questwords", 1058, null, "dialog"]], "Congratulations on becoming a member of Gens Vanert. Much will be asked of you in the name of our cause. Come see me whenever you require assistance concerning the gens.": [["questwords", 1059, null, "dialog"]], "You cannot join a gens if you are a member of the guild alliance. Leave the guild alliance and try joining the gens again.": [["questwords", 1060, null, "dialog"]], "Congratulations. You have contributed more to the cause of the gens than any other member. Duprian Winston rewards your accomplishments. I hope to see even greater achievements from you next month.": [["questwords", 1061, null, "dialog"]], "Oh! Thanks to your bravery, we were able to crush those good-for-nothing Duprians once again. This is a reward bestowed to you by Vanert Reicht himself for your contributions in battle. I hope to see you in action once again next month.": [["questwords", 1062, null, "dialog"]], "Gens Ranking Reward": [["questwords", 1063, null, "dialog"]], "Gens ranking rewards are given out in the first week of each month.": [["questwords", 1064, null, "dialog"]], "Regrettably, you are not eligible for a reward. Please try harder next time.": [["questwords", 1065, null, "dialog"]], "You do not have enough space for the item. Please free up your Inventory and try again.": [["questwords", 1066, null, "dialog"]], "The reward has already been handed out.": [["questwords", 1067, null, "dialog"]], "You have not joined the gens.": [["questwords", 1068, null, "dialog"]], "NPC dialog script error!": [["questwords", 1500, null, "dialog"]], "Select a quest.": [["questwords", 1501, null, "dialog"]], "There is no available quest. Please come back later.": [["questwords", 1502, null, "dialog"]], "Would you like to visit Chaos Castle, the arena of the gods? There is no better place to prove your strength. Why don't you listen to what I have to say and then decide? (Basic character: Level 15-49, Advanced character: Level 15-29)": [["questwords", 2001, null, "dialog"]], "Chaos Castle...": [["questwords", 2002, null, "dialog"], ["questwords", 2038, null, "dialog"]], "Very well. Tell me more.": [["questwords", 2003, null, "dialog"], ["questwords", 2039, null, "dialog"], ["questwords", 3003, null, "dialog"], ["questwords", 3039, null, "dialog"], ["questwords", 4003, null, "dialog"], ["questwords", 4039, null, "dialog"], ["questwords", 5003, null, "dialog"], ["questwords", 5033, null, "dialog"]], "I know it well. I hear you need an item to participate in the event....": [["questwords", 2004, null, "dialog"], ["questwords", 2040, null, "dialog"]], "You're well-informed. I will give you the item you need to access Chaos Castle. When you have time, come see me for an easy quest.": [["questwords", 2005, null, "dialog"], ["questwords", 2041, null, "dialog"]], "A wise decision. Chaos Castle is a battle field created by Lugard, the god of the heaven world, and Secrarium, the god of the underworld, for the balance of good and evil in this world. However, travelers started going to Chaos Castle and fighting on the side of Lugard, tipping the balance in disfavor of Secrarium.": [["questwords", 2006, null, "dialog"], ["questwords", 2042, null, "dialog"]], "To restore balance to the battle event, Secrarium made Lugard an offer and suggested implementation of a new rule. This rule was for everyone participating in the event to wear guardsman's armor. Lugard, believing the offer to be fair, accepted.": [["questwords", 2008, null, "dialog"], ["questwords", 2044, null, "d
@B 278x 24000
ialog"]], "I see.": [["questwords", 2009, null, "dialog"], ["questwords", 2045, null, "dialog"]], "Unfortunately, Secrarium was betting that darkness in the hearts of the travelers would ultimately lead to hostility and discord among them. Lugard was also aware of the travelers' dark side, but his trust in them didn't waver. Ultimately, the travelers did begin to feud with one another like the dark god had anticipated, and Chaos Castle became ever more... chaotic.": [["questwords", 2010, null, "dialog"], ["questwords", 2046, null, "dialog"]], "I guess Lugard was tricked by Secrarium. How do I participate?": [["questwords", 2011, null, "dialog"], ["questwords", 2047, null, "dialog"]], "It's very easy to enter Chaos Castle. Simply right-click on your Armor of Guardsman at the appropriate times (12:00am, 14:00pm, 16:00pm, 18:00pm, 20:00pm, and 22:00pm) to enter. Players in designated locations, such as a PC cafe, will have more opportunities to enter.": [["questwords", 2012, null, "dialog"], ["questwords", 2048, null, "dialog"]], "It really is easy to enter. What does the event involve, exactly?": [["questwords", 2013, null, "dialog"], ["questwords", 2049, null, "dialog"], ["questwords", 3013, null, "dialog"], ["questwords", 3049, null, "dialog"], ["questwords", 4013, null, "dialog"], ["questwords", 4049, null, "dialog"], ["questwords", 5013, null, "dialog"], ["questwords", 5043, null, "dialog"]], "You will stand by for about a minute before actually entering. The event starts once this standby time passes. Once it does start, travelers and corrupt guardsmen will fight each other to the death in a no-holds-barred melee.": [["questwords", 2014, null, "dialog"]], "Is there anything I need to be cautious of?": [["questwords", 2015, null, "dialog"], ["questwords", 2051, null, "dialog"]], "It doesn't matter with the travelers, but you have to be careful when you kill a corrupt guardsman. Corrupt guardsmen will explode and may even push you off the arena. If this happens, you will be disqualified.": [["questwords", 2016, null, "dialog"], ["questwords", 2052, null, "dialog"]], "It all makes sense now.": [["questwords", 2017, null, "dialog"], ["questwords", 2053, null, "dialog"], ["questwords", 4017, null, "dialog"], ["questwords", 4053, null, "dialog"], ["questwords", 5017, null, "dialog"], ["questwords", 5047, null, "dialog"]], "If you want to find out when you can enter, simply move your mouse over the Armor of Guardsman. If you want to enter, simply right-click on the armor at a designated time. Come see me when you have time, and I will give you a quest that will earn you the item needed to enter the event.": [["questwords", 2018, null, "dialog"], ["questwords", 2054, null, "dialog"]], "You are back sooner than I thought. Would you like to hear Archangel's request to help defend Blood Castle's barrier and join in the fight for the castle? (Basic character: Level 15-80, Advanced character: Level 10-60)": [["questwords", 3001, null, "dialog"]], "Blood Castle...": [["questwords", 3002, null, "dialog"], ["questwords", 3038, null, "dialog"]], "I know it well. I hear you need a special item to go there....": [["questwords", 3004, null, "dialog"], ["questwords", 3040, null, "dialog"]], "You're well-informed. In order to penetrate the barrier surrounding Blood Castle, you will need an Invisibility Cloak. If you pass a simple test of mine, I will provide you with an Invisibility Cloak before you head to Blood Castle. When you have time, come see me for an easy quest.": [["questwords", 3005, null, "dialog"], ["questwords", 3041, null, "dialog"]], "I will tell you then. Devildom's royal guards, who were summoned when Kundun succumbed to Secrarium, posed a great threat to the heaven world. To protect their base, the Twelve Saints formed a barrier around Blood Castle.": [["questwords", 3006, null, "dialog"], ["questwords", 3042, null, "dialog"]], "Kundun, however, must've anticipated such a move. He hid beyond the range of the barrier and eliminated the Twelve Saints as soon as the barrier was formed. Luckily, Archangel evaded that peril and sacrificed himself for the barrier.": [["questwords", 3008, null, "dialog"], ["questwords", 3044, null, "dialog"]], "Kundun's Royal Guards, however, continue to attack the barrier, and are weakening it. We need Archangel's weapon in order to prevent this weakening of the barrier, and that's why we are now seeking the help of travelers.": [["questwords", 3010, null, "dialog"], ["questwords", 3046, null, "dialog"]], "I see. How do I enter?": [["questwords", 3011, null, "dialog"], ["questwords", 3047, null, "dialog"], ["questwords", 4011, null, "dialog"], ["questwords", 4047, null, "dialog"], ["questwords", 5011, null, "dialog"], ["questwords", 5041, null, "dialog"]], "It's very easy to enter Blood Castle. The battle event takes place every two hours from 12:30am and on. To enter, take an Invisibility Cloak that's right for your level to the Messenger of Archangel in Devias, five minutes before a Blood Castle event commences and ask to join. The Messenger of Archangel will then send you to the castle.": [["questwords", 3012, null, "dialog"], ["questwords", 3048, null, "dialog"]], "You will stand by for about a minute before actually entering. You'll enter Blood Castle after this standby time has elapsed. Once inside Blood Castle, you can buy some time by defeating 40 monsters summoned by a necromancer named Red Skull.": [["questwords", 3014, null, "dialog"], ["questwords", 3050, null, "dialog"]], "Go past the castle gate and defeat two Red Skulls who have hidden the Absolute Weapon. This will buy you some more time and reveal a casket containing the weapon. Destroy the casket, defeat more monsters, and return the Absolute Weapon to Archangel to successfully complete the Blood Castle quest.": [["questwords", 3016, null, "dialog"], ["questwords", 3052, null, "dialog"]], "I understand.": [["questwords", 3017, null, "dialog"], ["questwords", 3053, null, "dialog"]], "To find out when you can enter, simply press the F1 key. If you want to enter, take an Invisibility Cloak that's right for your level to the Messenger of Archangel before the scheduled start time. Come see me when you have time, and I will give you a quest that will earn you the Invisibility Cloak so that you can enter Blood Castle.": [["questwords", 3018, null, "dialog"], ["questwords", 3054, null, "dialog"]], "You're back sooner than I thought. I have a quest that will earn you an item you'll need to enter Blood Castle. Will you accept this quest? (Basic character: Level 15-80, Advanced character: Level 10-60)": [["questwords", 3019, null, "dialog"]], "Very well. It appears Hell Hounds are causing quite a headache for novice travelers to the Dungeon these days. Hunt down 40 Hell Hounds, and I'll give you an Invisibility Cloak + 1 as a reward. At your current level, it'll be too dangerous for you to hunt the monsters alone. It'll be better if you hunt in a party.": [["questwords", 3024, null, "dialog"]], "In Blood Castle, you'll be fighting against time. Good armor and weapons will, of course, help you complete your quest. But more than anything else, solidarity of your party is what will count there. Will you accept Archangel's quest? (Basic character: Level 15-80, Advanced character: Level 10-60)": [["questwords", 3025, null, "dialog"]], "Of course. It's an opportune place to develop your skills. Why don't you listen to what I have to say and then decide? (Basic character: Level 15-130, Advanced character: Level 10-110)": [["questwords", 4001, null, "dialog"]], "Devil Square...": [["questwords", 4002, null, "dialog"], ["questwords", 4038, null, "dialog"]], "I already knew that.": [["questwords", 4004, null, "dialog"], ["questwords", 4040, null, "dialog"], ["questwords", 5004, null, "dialog"], ["questwords", 5034, null, "dialog"]], "You're well-informed. I'll give you the item you'll need to enter Devil Square. When you have time, come see me for an easy quest.": [["questwords", 4005, null, "dialog"], ["questwords", 4041, null, "dialog"]], "Devil Square is the place where the Elf Tree once stood. The Elf Tree was created by the mother of all Elves, an underground Elf known as Aria. This tree had the ability to produce Elves regularly. Then Secrarium tricked Lugard and appeared in Noria, at the location of the Elf Tree.": [["questwords", 4006, null, "dialog"], ["questwords", 4042, null, "dialog"]], "Having set his eyes on the tree's power of birth, Secrarium corrupted the Elf Tree and transformed it into an Immoral Tree that gave birth to monsters.  The monsters horde grew to astronomical proportions, and the kingdoms of the MU continent combined their forces to entrap the immoral tree in a space of nothingness.": [["questwords", 4008, null, "dialog"], ["questwords", 4044, null, "dialog"]], "Monsters, however, continued to spawn at regular intervals from the spot where the tree once stood. After careful consideration, the queen of the Elves decided to make a training arena of this place for travelers.": [["questwords", 4010, null, "dialog"], ["questwords", 4046, null, "dialog"]], "It's very easy to enter Devil Square. It can be entered every four hours from 3:00 a.m. and on (3:00 a.m., 7:00 a.m., 11:00 a.m., 3:00 p.m., 7:00 p.m., and 11:00 p.m.). To enter, take a Devil's Invitation that's right for your level to Charon in Noria five minutes before a scheduled entry time and ask to join. Charon will then send you to Devil Square.": [["questwords", 4012, null, "dialog"], ["questwords", 4048, null, "dialog"]], "You'll stand by for about a minute before actually entering. Once this standby time passes, monsters will start to appear. The monsters will continue to attack for ten minutes, and killing them will earn you points. If you score high enough, you might even receive a reward.": [["questwords", 4014, null, "dialog"], ["questwords", 4050, null, "dialog"]], "Is there anything I should know about Devil Square?": [["questwords", 4015, null, "dialog"], ["questwords", 4051, null, "dialog"]], "You'll face a steady stream of powerful monsters at Devil Square. Forming a party with other travelers before entering will give you a better chance of survival.": [["questwords", 4016, null, "dialog"], ["questwords", 4052, null, "dialog"]], "To find out when you can enter, press the F1 key. Then, take a Devil's Invitation that's right for your level to Charon in Noria five minutes before the entry time you've chosen. You'll be sent to Devil Square. Come see me when you have time, and I'll give you a quest that will earn you the item you need to enter Devil Square.": [["questwords", 4018, null, "dialog"], ["questwords", 4054, null, "dialog"]], "You are back sooner than I thought. I have a simple quest that will earn you an invitation granting you access to Devil Square. Will you accept this quest? (Basic character: Level 15-130, Advanced character: Level 10-110)": [["questwords", 4019, null, "dialog"]], "It seems Cursed Liches are tormenting the residents of Elveland with their dark spells and curses. Hunt down 40 of those Cursed Liches, and I'll give you a Devil's Invitation +1 as a reward. I suggest you work with others for faster results.": [["questwords", 4024, null, "dialog"]], "Devil Square provides an opportunity to train yourself and build your experience. Would you like to train at Devil Square? (All characters: Level 220-270)": [["questwords", 5001, null, "dialog"]], "Illusion Temple...": [["questwords", 5002, null, "dialog"], ["questwords", 5032, null, "dialog"]], "You're well-informed. I'm in charge of distributing items that are necessary to enter Illusion Temple. When you have time, come see me for an easy quest that will earn you a ticket in.": [["questwords", 5005, null, "dialog"], ["questwords", 5035, null, "dialog"]], "Illusion Spells, the foundation of Illusion Sorcery, was discovered by an Archaeologist named Mirage. Mirage found the spells' power to be too dangerous and sealed it. His partner Lev, however, stole the spells to brainwash people and establish Illusion Sorcery. Illusion Sorcery gradually grew larger and brought chaos to the continent.": [["questwords", 5006, null, "dialog"], ["questwords", 5036, null, "dialog"]], "Grand Wizard Etramu vowed to destroy Illusion Sorcery and formed an army to subjugate its followers. Under Etramu's command, the alliance engaged the followers of Illusion Sorcery with formidable force. Despite having been driven all the way back to Illusion Temple, the followers continued to resist. As battle raged on, Lev disappeared and left the followers of Illusion Sorcery in confusion. Ultimately, they all met their death at the hands of the alliance on the temple grounds.": [["questwords", 5008, null, "dialog"], ["questwords", 5038, null, "dialog"]], "Due to Lev's illusion spells, however, the souls of the dead followers remained in this world to defend the temple. These souls believed Lev's return would allow them to reclaim their bodies and continued to safeguard the temple. Today, the temple is guarded by the alliance in case Lev does actually return and Illusion Sorcery uses ancient relics to lure in unsuspecting travelers to their cause.": [["questwords", 5010, null, "dialog"], ["questwords", 5040, null, "dialog"]], "It's very easy to enter Illusion Temple. It can be entered every four hours from 01:00 a.m. and on: 01:00 a.m., 05:00 a.m., 09:00 a.m., 01:00 p.m., 05:00 p.m., and 09:00 p.m. To enter, take a Scroll of Blood that's right for your level to Mirage in Elveland five minutes before an Illusion Temple event commences and ask to join. Mirage will then send you to the temple.": [["questwords", 5012, null, "dialog"], ["questwords", 5042, null, "dialog"]], "Upon entering, you'll need to wait for other players to enter. The players will then be divided into two teams: Alliance Camp and Illusion Sorcery Camp. The camp that brings over more relics to their own side wins.": [["questwords", 5014, null, "dialog"], ["questwords", 5044, null, "dialog"]], "Is there anything I should be aware of about Illusion Temple?": [["questwords", 5015, null, "dialog"], ["questwords", 5045, null, "dialog"]], "You'll not be able to use certain skills like Teleport or Telekinesis while holding on to a relic. On the other hand, there are special skills that can only be used in Illusion Temple. Using these skills to your advantage will make it easier for your camp to win.": [["questwords", 5016, null, "dialog"], ["questwords", 5046, null, "dialog"]], "To find out when you can enter, press the F1 key. Then, take a Scroll of Blood that's right for your level to Mirage in Elveland five minutes before the entry time you've chosen. You'll then be sent to Illusion Temple. Come see me when you have time, and I'll give you a quest that will earn you the item needed to enter Illusion Temple.": [["questwords", 5018, null, "dialog"], ["questwords", 5048, null, "dialog"]], "You are back sooner than I thought. However, this applies only to Illusion Temple Level 6.": [["questwords", 5830, null, "dialog"]], "Illusion Temple Challenge (1)": [["questwords", 5901, null, "dialog"]], "Illusion Temple Challenge (2)": [["questwords", 5902, null, "dialog"]], "Illusion Temple Challenge (3)": [["questwords", 5903, null, "dialog"]], "Illusion Temple Adaptation (1)": [["questwords", 5904, null, "dialog"]], "Illusion Temple Adaptation (2)": [["questwords", 5905, null, "dialog"]], "Illusion Temple Adaptation (3)": [["questwords", 5906, null, "dialog"]], "Strange Confrontation (1)": [["questwords", 5907, null, "dialog"]], "Strange Confrontation (2)": [["questwords", 5908, null, "dialog"]], "Strange Confrontation (3)": [["questwords", 5909, null, "dialog"]], "Strange Confrontation (4)": [["questwords", 5910, null, "dialog"]], "There are a number of ways you can prove your worth on the continent of MU. You can try to be the last one standing in Chaos Castle, or work with your comrades to battle through Blood Castle, Devil Square, or Illusion Temple. Travelers regard such feats as some of the worthiest accomplishments one can achieve.": [["questwords", 6001, null, "dialog"]], "So it's not just about equipment or level.": [["questwords", 6002, null, "dialog"]], "That's right. You do need good equipment and a high level to test your mettle against other travelers, yes. But just that isn't enough for you to become a hero of MU. I will help you receive recognition as a hero by giving you a series of missions. You may repeat these missions as often as desired.": [["questwords", 6003, null, "dialog"]], "Recognition as a hero...": [["questwords", 6004, null, "dialog"]], "To start off, I'll give you a simple mission to see if you have the right qualities to be a hero. Will you accept this mission? (Basic character: Level 240 - 270, Advanced character: Level 220 - 260)": [["questwords", 6005, null, "dialog"]], "Sure! What's this simple mission about? (Accept)": [["questwords", 6007, null, "dialog"]], "I don't need to be judged like this! (Refuse)": [["questwords", 6008, null, "dialog"]], "I'm sorry to hear that. There are many ways to become stronger, but they'll all take time. Remember that well.": [["questwords", 6009, null, "dialog"]], "You have accepted the first trial. I want you to prove your combat prowess by defeating 5 Guardsmen in Chaos Castle, delivering Archangel's weapon in Blood Castle, and surviving till the end in Devil Square. Complete the mission and you'll be rewarded with either a Jewel of Bless, a Jewel of Soul, or a Jewel of Chaos.": [["questwords", 6010, null, "dialog"]], "Congratulations. You have completed the first mission. Then I will give you the second mission right away. Will you accept this mission? (Basic character: Level 240 - 270, Advanced character: Level 220 - 260)": [["questwords", 6011, null, "dialog"]], "I accept the mission. (Accept)": [["questwords", 6013, null, "dialog"], ["questwords", 6019, null, "dialog"], ["questwords", 6025, null, "dialog"]], "No, I need some rest first. (Refuse)": [["questwords", 6014, null, "dialog"], ["questwords", 6026, null, "dialog"]], "I'm sorry to hear that. You can't repeat the first mission if you abandon the second mission. You must complete the second mission before you can repeat the first mission. Please return if you change your mind.": [["questwords", 6015, null, "dialog"], ["questwords", 6027, null, "dialog"], ["questwords", 6039, null, "dialog"], ["questwords", 6051, null, "dialog"], ["questwords", 6063, null, "dialog"], ["questwords", 6075, null, "dialog"]], "Good decision. This mission requires you to raise your worth by claiming victory in Illusion Temple. Complete the mission and you'll be rewarded with 800,000 Exp.": [["questwords", 6016, null, "dialog"]], "You have completed the first trial to become a hero. The next mission I'll give you is to see if you have the courage to be a hero. Will you accept this mission? (Basic character: Level 300 - 320, Advanced character: Level 271 - 320)": [["questwords", 6017, null, "dialog"]], "I think I have enough courage already. (Refuse)": [["questwords", 6020, null, "dialog"]], "Courage is the most important trait for a hero. If you lack the proper courage, you can never be reborn as a hero.": [["questwords", 6021, null, "dialog"]], "Good decision. The first mission for the second trial involves defeating 10 Guardsmen in Chaos Castle, delivering Archangel's weapon in Blood Castle, and surviving until the end of Devil Square. Complete the mission and you'll be rewarded with either a Jewel of Bless, a Jewel of Soul, a Jewel of Chaos, or a Jewel of Harmony.": [["questwords", 6022, null, "dialog"]], "Congratulations. You have completed the first mission. Then I will give you the second mission right away. Will you accept this mission? (Basic character: Level 300 - 320, Advanced character: Level 271 - 320)": [["questwords", 6023, null, "dialog"]], "Then I will give you the second mission right away. Show no fear against a number of foes at once, and attain victory in Illusion Temple. Complete the mission and you'll be rewarded with 3,000,000 Exp.": [["questwords", 6028, null, "dialog"]], "You have now completed the second trial to become a hero. The next mission I'll give you is to see if you have the fighting spirit to be a hero. Will you accept this mission? (Level 331 - 350)": [["questwords", 6029, null, "dialog"]], "It's fighting spirit this time? I accept the mission. (Accept)": [["questwords", 6031, null, "dialog"]], "A fighting spirit doesn't benefit a hero. (Refuse)": [["questwords", 6032, null, "dialog"]], "I hope you realize that a hero without a fighting spirit is merely a coward.": [["questwords", 6033, null, "dialog"]], "You've made a wise choice. The first mission for the third trial involves defeating 20 Guardsmen in Chaos Castle, delivering Archangel's weapon in Blood Castle, and surviving until the end of Devil Square. Complete the mission and you'll be rewarded with either a Jewel of Bless, a Jewel of Life, a Jewel of Harmony, or two Jewels of Soul.": [["questwords", 6034, null, "dialog"]], "Congratulations. You have completed the first mission. Then I will give you the second mission right away. Will you accept this mission? (Level 331 - 350)": [["questwords", 6035, null, "dialog"]], "This one might be a little challenging, eh? I accept the mission. (Accept)": [["questwords", 6037, null, "dialog"]], "I am not ready yet. (Refuse)": [["questwords", 6038, null, "dialog"], ["questwords", 6068, null, "dialog"]], "Then I will give you the second mission right away. Shock your rivals out of their senses by attaining a victory in Illusion Temple. Complete the mission and you'll be rewarded with 5,000,000 Exp.": [["questwords", 6040, null, "dialog"]], "You have now completed the third trial to become a hero. The next mission I'll give you is to see if you have the right mentality to be a hero. Will you accept this mission? (Level 351 - 380)": [["questwords", 6041, null, "dialog"]], "I'll stay focused until the very end! (Accept)": [["questwords", 6043, null, "dialog"]], "I have no time right now. (Refuse)": [["questwords", 6044, null, "dialog"]], "A hero without strong mind is little better than a corpse. Please continue challenging yourself until the end.": [["questwords", 6045, null, "dialog"]], "Good decision. The first mission of the fourth trial involves defeating 30 Guardsmen in Chaos Castle, delivering Archangel's weapon in Blood Castle, and surviving until the end of Devil Square. Complete the mission and you'll be rewarded with either a Jewel of Bless, a Jewel of Life, a Jewel of Harmony, or two Jewels of Soul.": [["questwords", 6046, null, "dialog"]], "Congratulations. You have completed the first mission. Then I will give you the second mission right away. Will you accept this mission? (Level 351 - 380)": [["questwords", 6047, null, "dialog"]], "It's becoming more and more difficult. I accept the mission. (Accept)": [["questwords", 6049, null, "dialog"], ["questwords", 6061, null, "dialog"]], "I give up. Going any further is beyond me. (Refuse)": [["questwords", 6050, null, "dialog"]], "Then I will give you the second mission right away. Protect the sacred item and don't give up before you are victorious in Illusion Temple. Complete the mission and you'll be rewarded with 8,000,000 Exp.": [["questwords", 6052, null, "dialog"]], "You have now completed the fourth trial to become a hero. The next mission I'm about to give you is to see if you have the tenacity to be a hero. Will you accept this mission? (Level 381 - 400)": [["questwords", 6053, null, "dialog"]], "A hero is relentless. I accept. (Accept)": [["questwords", 6055, null, "dialog"]], "I don't have the time right now. (Refuse)": [["questwords", 6056, null, "dialog"]], "Tenacity is another trait that a hero can't do without. Please remember that you can't get stronger if you aren't tenacious enough.": [["questwords", 6057, null, "dialog"]], "Good decision. The first mission of the fifth trial involves surviving in Chaos Castle, delivering Archangel's weapon in Blood Castle, and surviving until the end of Devil Square. (Accept)": [["questwords", 6067, null, "dialog"]], "This door will not always be open to you.": [["questwords", 6069, null, "dialog"]], "Good decision.
